title: Full pt-BR localization coverage and reactive language switching

requirements.summary: Replace all remaining hardcoded UI strings with i18n translation keys across authenticated screens, tabs, and empty/conditional states.
acceptanceCriteria: In ParentDashboard, all visible strings are translated via t(...) (e.g., titles, descriptions, tab labels, alert text, empty-state text).
In ChildHome, all visible strings are translated via t(...) (e.g., headings, descriptions, supervision notice, pairing warning, tab labels, card titles/descriptions).
In AdminPanel, all visible strings are translated via t(...) (e.g., headings, descriptions, tab labels, section titles/descriptions, empty-state text).
No user-visible English strings remain in the authenticated app flows when language is set to pt-BR (excluding user-generated content such as names and free-text notes).

Replace hardcoded AdminPanel strings (page title/description, tab labels, section titles/descriptions, empty-state 'no pairings' message) with t(...) keys.

Replace all hardcoded pairing UI strings and toast messages with t(...) keys (card title/description, warning alert title/body, button labels, 'your pairing code' label, copy success text, helper/expiry text).
Audit for any remaining hardcoded table/dialog text and replace with t(...) keys (headers, status labels, action labels, confirmation copy, placeholders, loading states).
Replace any remaining hardcoded admin gate UI strings (headings, instructions, input labels, button text, error/help text) with t(...) keys.
Ensure all metric card titles/labels are sourced from t(...) keys (no hardcoded labels).
Replace any remaining hardcoded child alerts UI strings (titles/descriptions, empty state, request-more-time section copy, textarea placeholder, submit button/loading) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded parent alerts UI strings (titles/descriptions, empty state) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded audit table strings (loading/empty text, column headers, action labels) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded check-in UI strings (tab labels, form titles, labels, placeholders, consent text, preview text, submit/loading states, validation/help text) with t(...) keys.
Ensure consent notice titles/messages use t(...) keys only (no hardcoded strings).
Replace any remaining hardcoded activity history strings (loading/empty states, table headers/labels, 'no notes' placeholder, units formatting label) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded location history strings (loading/empty states, table headers/labels) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded content filter editor strings (titles/descriptions, section headings, placeholders, save/loading text, note text) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded read-only filter strings (loading/empty states, headings/labels, status labels) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded schedule editor strings (title/description, alert text, field labels, day names, add/remove/save/loading) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded schedule read-only strings (loading/empty states, title/description, labels) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded strings in the child summary card (title, counts, 'last check-in' label, 'no check-ins yet' label) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded parent activity view strings (transparency notice copy, headings if present) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded parent location view strings (transparency notice copy, headings if present) with t(...) keys.
Replace any remaining hardcoded footer strings with t(...) keys (keep dynamic values like year/hostname as params where needed).
Audit authenticated flows and any conditional/empty states rendered by App for remaining hardcoded strings and replace with t(...) keys (do not modify frontend/src/main.tsx).

requirements.summary: Expand and align en/pt-BR translation dictionaries to cover all UI text keys while preserving strong typing and en fallback behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Any new translation keys introduced during the hardcoded-string removal are added to both frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts and frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts.
The app compiles with strong typing preserved for TranslationKey usage (no `any`-typed translation keys introduced).
When a key is missing in pt-BR, the UI falls back to the en value instead of displaying the raw key.

file_operations.description: Add any missing translation keys introduced by REQ-1 refactors (including newly discovered strings from dashboards, tabs, dialogs, toasts, and empty states) and keep `TranslationKey` strongly typed via the `as const` dictionary.
Add complete pt-BR translations for every key in en.ts (including new keys introduced by REQ-1), ensuring the dictionary fully mirrors the English keyset.
Keep translations typed as `Record<Locale, Record<TranslationKey, string>>` and adjust as needed to ensure compile-time coverage while maintaining en as the fallback via I18nProvider behavior.
Confirm fallback behavior remains `pt-BR` → `en` → raw key, and (if needed) harden typing around `t(key: TranslationKey, ...)` so no `any` keys are introduced during refactors.

requirements.summary: Ensure language switching re-renders all mounted and newly rendered UI (including tabs and dialogs) immediately without refresh and persists via localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing the language from the LanguageSelector updates text immediately across the current page and any open modal/dialog (where applicable) without a full page reload.
After switching language, moving between tabs in ParentDashboard/ChildHome/AdminPanel shows the correct localized text in each tab’s content.
Language selection persists across reloads via the existing localStorage mechanism (appLanguage).

file_operations.description: Verify LanguageSelector triggers reactive updates by using the i18n context state directly (no cached labels outside render) and ensure the button title/labels are always derived from t(...).
Ensure i18n context updates trigger re-render for all consumers and keep language persistence via localStorage key appLanguage; avoid patterns that freeze translated strings at mount time.
Verify the modal’s full content is rendered from t(...) keys so switching language while the modal is open updates immediately without closing/reopening.
Verify this modal renders all labels/buttons from t(...) at render time so switching language while the dialog is open updates immediately.

Ensure tab labels/content headers are not stored in state/memo without language dependencies; all strings should be derived from t(...) during render so switching language updates current and future tab content.
Ensure tab labels and conditional alert text re-render from t(...) immediately on language change (avoid initializing translated strings into state).
Ensure tab labels and empty state text are derived from t(...) during render so language changes are reflected immediately when switching tabs.
